description: Read back a customer's recent usage logs (most recent first). Use it to CONFIRM a signal landed — after running the product's code so it fires a real signal, check the event shows up with the expected model, tokens, and cost. This is the ONLY proof a real signal landed: the MCP cannot record usage, and ingest is asynchronous, so a signal your code 'sent' is not billed until it appears here.

limit.description: Max usage rows to return (most recent first).

name: clocknext_get_customer_usage
title: ClockNext: get customer usage
